name: Lebor Gabála Érenn

attributes.attribute: Irish title of the Book of Invasions

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Lebor Gabála Érenn is the Irish title of the Book of Invasions. The name means the book of the taking of Ireland. The text lists the invasions of Ireland. It reached its known form in the twelfth century.

okr.objective: Point the reader to the Book of Invasions.
